description: "A Discourse on the Life, Character and Writings of Gulian Crommelin Verplanck" by William Cullen Bryant is a biographical text delivered as a speech before the New York Historical Society in the late 19th century. This discourse details the life and contributions of Gulian Crommelin Verplanck, an influential figure in American literature, law, and public service.
